lowStarReviews.title: Severely Limited Customization & Workout Logic
lowStarReviews.text: This app worked well for me at first, but once I started building my own workouts, the limitations became really frustrating. The customization options are extremely limited and sometimes confusing. For example, I couldn’t select something as basic as an assisted underhand pull-up, and creating functional movements is almost impossible. There’s no way to build exercises that use both time and weight, like a farmer’s carry. Even trying to create a simple sprint workout is restrictive — you’re forced into generic “running” options with set time increments instead of being able to program intervals properly. The exercise library also feels incomplete. There are missing machine exercises and not enough variety overall. It would be a huge improvement if users could submit custom exercises to be added to the app. On top of that, the auto-generated workouts don’t seem to follow solid training principles. A “back workout” will often include multiple variations of the same movement (like two different lat pulldowns) instead of providing balanced variety. There doesn’t seem to be much consideration for how to train different muscle groups effectively or structure a well-rounded workout. Overall, the app is a decent starting point, but it falls short if you’re trying to train with intention, variety, and proper programming.

lowStarReviews.title: It WAS a great app.
lowStarReviews.text: I have been a user of this app for many years now. Unfortunately, many of the features are being placed behind the pay wall. You can no longer use your smart watch. You have to pay to do that. And now, unfortunately, you cannot save exercises individually without paying to unlock this.  To explain, when you save a certain weight and rep amount, it overrides all previous weights and reps for the same exercise in the routine. Warm-ups get overwritten with the last weight and rep that you entered. Again, you have to pay... to unlock the ability to save exercises individually, instead of having changes applied to the entire set. The frustrating thing is, after many messages to customer service, assuming that it was an issue with my phone, the rep tried troubleshooting without success. After many emails, over a period of days, eventually he said "actually you have to pay for that"... This use to be a great app! Unfortunately, not so much anymore. After many years, I am looking for a reliable replacement.
